svg.title: The boundary
svg.desc: Close on the corner of a stone wall at the end of a day. A bench mark has just been cut into the newest course, its cuts still bright, a short hash scratched beneath it and the older marks of earlier courses below. A mallet stands on the finished stone against a low sun. A storey pole at the corner holds the red line one course higher, over stones that are only dashed outlines, and a plumb line hangs past the corner.
